name: Lilis Faw
source:
From: Heavy Metal L-Gaim
A survivor of the Mirali, one of Pentagona's indigenous peoples. After Daba rescued her from a circus, Lilis joins his crew. Though unwilling to open up to humans, she grew more comfortable around them in time, eventually forming an emotional bond with Daba and the others.
translation:
From: Heavy Metal L-Gaim
A survivor of the Mirali, one of Pentagona's indigenous peoples. After Daba rescued her from a circus, Lilis joins his crew. Though unwilling to open up to humans, she grew more comfortable around them in time, eventually forming an emotional bond with Daba and the others.
